title: Clawboo marketplace pack, schema version 1
description: The PUBLIC specification for a Clawboo marketplace pack. packages/pack-format is the TypeScript mirror of this file, used inside the Clawboo repo; a third party authors a pack against this schema and installs nothing. schemaVersion is the dispatch key: a reader validates at the declared version, upgrades, and validates again. It is never assumed.

schemaVersion.description: The pack format version. An INTEGER, not a semver, and not optional: a pack with no schemaVersion is a pack of unknown shape.

idPrefix.description: Entry-id prefix. Defaults to `id`. Lets the pack 'agency-agents' emit ids prefixed 'agency-'.

version.description: An EXACT semver of the CONTENT. Ranges ('^1.2.3', '1.x') are rejected: this names the one build of the content in this file.

counts.description: Must agree with the lengths of the three arrays below.

newCategories.description: Taxonomy values this pack introduces that the host does not already know. Declaring one is what turns a new category into a reviewable line in the content PR instead of a silent new filter chip.

renames.description: Former entry id -> current id, or null when the entry was removed. Entry bookkeeping, NOT schema migration.

kebab.description: Flat kebab-case. Entry ids become filenames and URL segments.

hexColor.description: Six-digit hex. Cards concatenate alpha suffixes onto it (`${color}18`), so an hsl() value would render transparent.

skillCategory.description: CLOSED, deliberately: shared with the Ghost Graph capability model.

entryOrigin.description: Per-entry attribution, for a pack whose entries do not all share one upstream. Omitted entries inherit the pack-level provenance.

provenance.description: Lives ONCE per pack. Replaces a per-entry source + sourceUrl pair.

ref.description: Commit sha or tag the import was taken at.

agentListing.description: What a CARD renders. The prose lives in the body document this points at.

id.description: Must equal `${idPrefix ?? id}-${slug}` and be unique across the pack's agents AND teams.

category.description: OPEN taxonomy. A value the host does not know must be declared in newCategories.

skillIds.description: Resolved against the MERGED registry: the host's builtin skills plus this pack's own `skills` additions. A pack may reference a builtin without redeclaring it, and must not redeclare one.

body.description: Relative path to this entry's AgentBody document.

teamMemberRef.description: Denormalised so cards render count + roles with no body fetch.

agentId.description: Must name an agent in this pack.

id.description: Must not collide with a host builtin skill id: the builtin wins the merge, so a colliding pack skill would be silently discarded.

agentBody.description: One agent's document set, at the relative path its listing names. SOUL.md and IDENTITY.md are required: they are the two files the deploy path cannot synthesize. AGENTS.md and CLAWBOO.md are built per-deploy from the team topology and never appear in a pack.

routing.description: Per-member AGENTS.md routing content, keyed by agent id.
